demos.name: MCP inspector
demos.description: Connect to an MCP server, list its tools, resources and prompts, scan them, then call tools behind a confirm step. One app with the scanner (D4).
demos.notes: Host-run: npm start (port 4810, loopback only). Or: docker compose up --build -d (publishes 127.0.0.1:4810 only). composeFile is relative to the shelf's demo root (the folder that holds the repo clones). D3 and D4 are one app, so docs/shelf-entry.json lists it twice with the same URL.

demos.name: MCP scanner
demos.description: Scan the metadata an MCP server serves, or a pasted tools/list snapshot, for tool poisoning before an agent reads it. Reports; never blocks. Same app as the inspector (D3).
demos.notes: Host-run: npm start (port 4810, loopback only). Or: docker compose up --build -d (publishes 127.0.0.1:4810 only). composeFile is relative to the shelf's demo root (the folder that holds the repo clones). D3 and D4 are one app, so docs/shelf-entry.json lists it twice with the same URL.
